description: List long-term SMS RENTAL numbers: keep the same receive-only number for days to months and receive multiple SMS (fair-use 25/day). Shows each country with its rentalId, duration tiers, live prices, and LIVE STOCK per duration — skip tiers marked OUT OF STOCK. US/UK numbers are real mobile (non-VoIP); Canada is VoIP. Not allowed for banking/financial/crypto-exchange verification. Purchase with rent_sms_number.
